goal: Provide an interactive wizard to coordinate multisig descriptor wallet setup across participants
Eliminate manual key derivation, descriptor assembly, and cumbersome RPC workarounds
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Concept approval because in-repo tooling protects users from less-reviewed alternatives (BenWestgate)
Suggested keeping the wizard as an external script outside the repository (sedited)

categories.name: tools
why: P3 because it automates a tedious and error-prone multisig wallet coordination workflow
Contrib scripts offer useful setup automation but are deferrable compared to core node tools
